text:
Sam K.: Heads-up: I'm rolling a tighter HSM/KMS unwrap policy for session-ticket encryption keys to limit cross-account decrypts. Posting changes for quick eyes before apply.
Priya D.: paste the policy you're about to apply? want to check resource and principal scoping.
Sam K.: plan = replace project-wide decrypt with binding scoped to key resource ARNs in projects/infra-kms and condition on request.auth.claims.sub == 'serviceAccount:keystore@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com'. Snippet in thread.
Theo G.: sounds good. note that some older edge proxies use an SDK that issues Decrypt RPCs with resourceName like `projects/infra-kms/cryptoKeyVersions/12` (skips keyRing/cryptoKey segments). make sure condition patterns cover that.
ops-bot: ALERT: 2951235123 - session-resume-decrypt-failure spike in us-west-2 (18 fails / 2m).
Nia H.: seeing TLS resumption errors from edge-uswest fleet: "session ticket unwrap failed: KMS.UnwrapError: AccessDenied". Affected hosts started showing errors at 14:02 UTC.
Sam K.: that was inside the rollout window (14:00). rolling back if needed.
Priya D.: before rollback, can you run audit query to see protoPayload.resourceName and principal? Use: `protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND protoPayload.status.code=7` and filter by project=infra-kms.
Theo G.: ran query and pasted two samples: resourceName is `projects/infra-kms/cryptoKeyVersions/12` and caller is `serviceAccount:keystore@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Condition mismatch is likely because our condition used startsWith('/keyRings/tickets') which doesn't match the abbreviated form.
Sam K.: ack. two options: 1) broaden condition to allow the cryptoKeyVersion path pattern, 2) grant a temporary time-bounded decrypt on infra-kms to the keystore service. Which do folks prefer for minimal blast radius?
Nia H.: temp grant + reduce keystore unwrap retry aggressively on proxies. We're seeing retry storms — tickets tried to unwrap every 100ms leading to CPU spikes. Throttle to exponential backoff for canary hosts.
ops-bot: SUGGESTION: update keystore to fallback to in-memory software-ticket-unseal for a small percentage if KMS unwrap fails, to reduce customer impact during rollout.
Priya D.: I prefer temp grant with auto-expiry + follow-up to fix condition. Sam, can you add a condition on request.time < timestamp("2026-07-02T15:00:00Z") so it auto-expires?
Sam K.: applying time-bounded grant now. command: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/infra-kms/locations/us-west2/keyRings/tickets/cryptoKeys/session-ticket --member=serviceAccount:keystore@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-07-02T15:00:00Z")'`
ops-bot: NOTE: use audit filter `protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND resource.labels.project_id="infra-kms"` to follow up.
Theo G.: grant applied at 14:12 UTC. monitoring. Also lowered unwrap retry on canary proxies.
Nia H.: errors dropped to near 0 within 5m. session resumes recovered.
Sam K.: next steps: 1) update policy template to match both `cryptoKey` and `cryptoKeyVersions` resourceName patterns (regex), 2) add unit test in infra-iam to assert policy condition matches known protoPayload examples, 3) implement a short-circuit fallback in keystore to use local-ticket fallback for <0.5% of traffic during future rollouts, 4) add an audit-alert rule for KMS Decrypt denies tied to session-ticket jobs.
Priya D.: I'll own the IAM template and tests. Theo, can you own code change for retry backoff and software fallback?
Theo G.: yes will PR today. fallback will be opt-in behind a feature flag and default to off until tested in canary.
ops-bot: UPDATE: 2951236789 - KMS.DecryptAccessDenied reduced to 0 in us-west-2 after grant.
Nia H.: scheduling a short blameless postmortem and a Wednesday sync to finalize template and rollout checklist. Also recommend adding HSM/KMS region aliasing note in runbooks (some regions log resourceName differently).
Sam K.: filing the incident ticket and linking this thread. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
